questions.question: Which Article of the Indian Constitution describes the Fundamental Duties of citizens?
questions.explanation: Article 51A enlists the Fundamental Duties of citizens.

questions.question: What is the name of the highest court in the State of West Bengal?
questions.explanation: Calcutta High Court is the highest court in West Bengal.

questions.question: Which of the following is a characteristic of the President of India?
options: He is the head of the legislative
He is the head of the executive
He is the head of the judiciary
He is the head of the West Bengal State
questions.explanation: The President is the head of the executive.

questions.question: What is the name of the Constitution (Part III) which enlists the Fundamental Rights?
questions.explanation: Part III of the Constitution lists the Fundamental Rights.

questions.question: Which of the following is a feature of the Panchayati Raj system in West Bengal?
questions.explanation: West Bengal has a three-tier Panchayat system.

questions.question: Which of the following acts passed by the British government led to the Bengal Famine of 1943?
options: The Bengal Ingress into Bengal Act
questions.explanation: The Defence of India Act.

questions.question: Who was the president of the first session of the Indian National Congress held in Bengal?
questions.explanation: Gopal Krishna Gokhale.

questions.question: Which of the following events marked the beginning of the Non-Cooperation Movement in Bengal?
questions.explanation: Khilafat Movement.

questions.question: Who was the Bengal leader associated with the Partition of Bengal?
questions.explanation: Satish Chandra Mukherjee.

questions.question: Which of the following freedom fighters was martyred in Bengal during the Quit India Movement?
questions.explanation: Pritilata Waddedar.

questions.question: What is the name of the largest delta in the world, located in West Bengal?
questions.explanation: The largest delta in the world is located in southwestern Bangladesh and eastern India.

questions.question: Which of the following rivers forms the international border between West Bengal and Bangladesh?
questions.explanation: The Ganges River forms the border between India and Bangladesh.

questions.question: What is the name of the highest peak in the Darjeeling Himalayan hill region of West Bengal?
questions.explanation: Sandakphu is the highest peak in the Darjeeling Himalayan hill region of West Bengal.

questions.question: Which of the following districts in West Bengal is known for its tea plantations?
questions.explanation: Darjeeling district is known for its tea plantations.

questions.question: Which river originates from the Himalayas and flows through the state of West Bengal?
questions.explanation: The Ganges River originates from the Himalayas and flows through the state of West Bengal.

questions.question: Which of the following is a flagship program of the West Bengal government for providing financial assistance to the poor and marginalized?
questions.explanation: Swasthya Sathi is a health insurance scheme.

questions.question: The West Bengal government has launched a program to provide free bicycles to school-going girls, which of the following is the name of this scheme?
questions.explanation: Sabooj Sathi is a free bicycle distribution scheme.

questions.question: Which of the following is the name of a West Bengal government scheme aimed at providing financial assistance to the beneficiaries for constructing their own homes?
questions.explanation: Banglar Basta is a housing scheme.

questions.question: The West Bengal government has launched a program to provide financial assistance to the students of the state, which of the following is the name of this scheme?
questions.explanation: Sikshashree is a scholarship scheme.

questions.question: Which of the following is a West Bengal government initiative to provide health insurance coverage to the citizens of the state?
questions.explanation: Swasthya Sathi is a health insurance scheme.

questions.question: A person deposited Rs. 5,000 for 2 years at 8% per annum simple interest. Calculate the interest earned.
questions.explanation: Interest is calculated as (Principal * Rate * Time) / 100.

questions.question: A bank offers 5.5% compound interest on deposits. If Rs. 12,000 is deposited for 3 years, what is the amount at the end of the third year?
questions.explanation: Compound interest is calculated using the formula A = P(1 + r/n)^(nt).

questions.question: West Bengal government fixed a certain rate of interest for fixed deposit. If a person deposits Rs. 15,000 for 4 years at 7% per annum compound interest, what is the amount at the end of the fourth year?
questions.explanation: The amount is calculated using the formula A = P(1 + r/n)^(nt).

questions.question: If an amount is deposited for 3 years at 6% compound interest per annum, what is the ratio of the amount at the end of the third year to the principal amount?
questions.explanation: The ratio is calculated using the formula (1 + r/n)^(nt).

questions.question: A woman borrowed Rs. 8,000 at 10% per annum simple interest for 2 years. How much she should pay at the end of the second year?
questions.explanation: Interest is calculated as (Principal * Rate * Time) / 100.

questions.question: A person can complete 1/4th of a job in 3 hours. How much time will he take to complete 3/4th of the job?
questions.explanation: He will take 9 hours to complete 3/4th of the job.

questions.question: The water tank can fill in 6 hours. If water flows from 3 pipes, how much time will it take to fill the tank?
questions.explanation: It will take 2 hours to fill the tank.

questions.question: A group of men can finish a work in 12 days. If 1/4th of the men are absent, how many days will it take to complete the work?
questions.explanation: It will take 30 days to complete the work.

questions.question: A man can fill a tank in 4 hours, and another man can fill the same tank in 8 hours. How many hours will it take to fill the tank if both men work together?
questions.explanation: It will take 2.5 hours to fill the tank.

questions.question: A pump can fill 2/3rd of a tank in 6 hours. How much time will it take to fill the full tank?
questions.explanation: It will take 9 hours to fill the full tank.

questions.question: If 'D' is coded as '2', 'A' is coded as '14', 'T' as '8', and 'E' as '5', then what is the code for 'DATE'?
questions.explanation: The letters are replaced by their corresponding numerical positions in the alphabet.

questions.explanation: Each number corresponds to the position of a letter in the alphabet.

questions.question: If we have a code like: W=4, X=3, Y=6, Z=5. What is the code for the word 'XYZ'?
questions.explanation: Each letter is replaced by its corresponding numerical value.

questions.question: In a certain code, 'A' is coded as '1', 'B' as '2', 'C' as '3', and so on. What is the code for the word 'BENGAL'?
questions.explanation: Each letter is replaced by its alphabetical position.

questions.question: A code is given as: 6 12 5. If we replace 6 with 'F', 12 with 'L', and 5 with 'I', then what is the correct code in words?
questions.explanation: Each number corresponds to the position of a letter in the alphabet.

questions.question: Kolkata is the ancestral city of Anirban, whose mother is the sister of his paternal grandmother. How is Anirban's brother related to him?
questions.explanation: Anirban's brother is his sibling.

questions.question: If Dibya is the only child of Bhavna and Bhavna's husband, and Dibya's father is the son of Bhavna's mother, what is the relationship of Bhavna's mother's husband to Dibya?
questions.explanation: Bhavna's mother's husband is Dibya's grandfather.

questions.question: In a family, there is a son named Rohan whose mother is the daughter of his maternal grandmother. What is the relationship of Rohan's wife to his maternal grandmother?
questions.explanation: Rohan's wife is the granddaughter of Rohan's maternal grandmother.

questions.question: Kolkata is the ancestral city of Anirban, whose wife is the daughter of his maternal grandmother. How is Anirban's father-in-law related to him?
questions.explanation: Anirban's father-in-law is his father.

questions.question: In a family, there are two sisters, Srijani and Srijata. Srijani's wife is the sister of Srijata. What is the relationship of Srijata's husband to Srijani?
questions.explanation: Srijata's husband is the brother-in-law of Srijani.

questions.question: If Anirban walks 15 km east from Howrah, then turns left and walks 10 km, where will he be?
questions.explanation: He will be at Sealdah.

questions.question: If a man walks 3 km towards the north from a point A, turns left and walks 2 km, and then turns right and walks 5 km, where will he be?
questions.explanation: He will be north of A.

questions.question: From the Maidan, a man walks 2.5 km towards the east. Then he turns right and walks 1.8 km. In which direction is he from the Maidan?
questions.explanation: He is to the east of the Maidan.

questions.question: A person stands at the point of intersection of Dakshineswar and Howrah Bridge. He moves 2.5 km east and then 1.2 km towards the north, then turns right and walks 1 km. In which direction is he from his initial position?
questions.explanation: He is to the north of his initial position.

questions.question: If a man walks 5 km towards the north from point B, then turns right and walks 4 km then turns left and walks 3.5 km, where will he be?
questions.explanation: He will be south of B.
